verdict.rationale: Kick's docs confirm bank/credit-card connection via Plaid with automatic transaction sync ('every transaction in Kick comes from a bank feed or an import'), AI categorization triggered 'when transactions sync into Kick', and a PDF/CSV fallback for institutions Plaid doesn't cover. This clearly delivers the core capability, though the exact 'daily' cadence isn't explicitly stated and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of sync reliability. Missing for 10: explicit statement of daily sync frequency, independent verification of import reliability.
